overwrite_test_expected_slice: run the script to overwrite expected slice values in test files using a correct results file
overwrite_file_function: run overwrite_file to replace a specific test assertion line in a Python test file
main_function_correct_only: run main with a correct filename to overwrite all expected slices in test files
main_function_with_failures: run main with correct and fail filenames to overwrite only failed test expected slices
parse_correct_file_format: run the script to parse a correct file with entries in file::class::test::line format
